projects.description: Three BAPS teams partnered with the Virginia Discovery Museum this spring — covering outreach strategy, internal organizational structure, and volunteer onboarding — to help the museum grow its community reach and streamline day-to-day operations.

Building on last semester's work, two teams continued partnering with MD Ortho — one focused on system design, and a second on media and marketing strategy — to further improve adoption of their virtual care platform.
BAPS continued its partnership with SWAT into the spring, wrapping up the semester's systems work with a final presentation of recommendations and deliverables.

projects.tag: 3 project teams · Strategy, Dues & Web Development
projects.description: Three teams worked with The For Good Project this spring, covering a final strategic deliverable, a dues tracking and strategy proposal, and a full website build — together supporting the organization's “collective for change” mission.
Our team developed a funding strategy presentation for Societal AI to help support the organization's continued growth and mission.
Our team partnered with the Virginia AI Safety Initiative on a project supporting the organization's mission to advance safe and responsible AI development at UVA.

Our team partnered with MD Ortho (virtual orthopedic care) to improve the utilization, adoption, and awareness of their software — specifically targeting older and less tech-savvy users. We built an automated messaging system for text/email reminders, a demonstrational sign-up video, and a feedback loop through a user experience survey.

This team partnered with Robin to improve the marketing of their internship/employment outreach platform. We explored strategies to expand Robin's reach at UVA, recommending targeted CIO outreach, high-impact TikTok and LinkedIn content scheduling, and SEO improvements for better website discovery.

Two BAPS teams partnered with NSBE this fall. One built a sponsorship proposal to help grow corporate partnerships and funding, while a second focused on broader outreach strategy — together supporting the chapter's ability to fund and expand its initiatives.
Two BAPS teams worked with SWAT this semester, developing internal tools and a final systems deliverable to help the organization run its operations more efficiently.

projects.tag: 2 project teams · Opportunity Curation & Selection Tools
projects.description: Two teams built internal tools for PSP this fall — an opportunity curation tool and a selection tool — to streamline how the organization evaluates and manages incoming opportunities for its members.

Continuing BAPS's partnership with SWAP, this fall's team tackled a storage logistics project alongside a broader strategic presentation, building on the expansion and transition work from the previous year.
Our team built a new website for Chocolate MYLK Club (“making young leaders knowledgable”) to help the organization establish an online presence and better reach and support young leaders.

Our team built an automated tracking system for FoodAssist to help staff see when volunteers arrived and left their shifts throughout the week, replacing manual sign-in tracking with something reliable and easy to maintain.

“We were tasked with designing the educational program for Josie’s Way. We gathered student input through surveys, consulted with faculty experts across Engineering, Architecture, and Education, and studied successful project-based learning models at UVA and other universities. We ultimately proposed a semester-long, interdisciplinary course that emphasizes community impact, hands-on learning, and student ownership, and piloted early components through a design prototype in Reid Bailey’s class.”

“Our team worked with Madison House to streamline their background checking process, which was previously time-consuming and prone to human error. We built a tool that automatically filters out duplicate entries from uploaded spreadsheets and consolidates data into a single, clean file — reducing steps, minimizing human error, and simplifying the overall workflow.”

projects.tag: 2 project teams · Exec Transition & Global Expansion
projects.description: “Our team partnered with SWAP to design a strategic expansion plan for launching a new chapter at Utrecht University, ultimately recommending a low-barrier pilot through a partnership with Utrecht’s Thrift Shack. A second team worked in parallel to improve SWAP’s executive transition process, helping the organization hand off institutional knowledge more smoothly between leadership teams.”

“We developed a networking and fundraising strategy to sustain the UVA Wheelchair Tennis Club, proposing a multi-pronged plan including a joint tournament with Club Tennis and a UVARec takeover. Two additional teams focused on recruitment and exec team restructuring, and on media and events — together aiming to increase visibility and secure the club’s future at UVA.”

“Our team created a comprehensive strategic outreach package to help YellowRed expand its presence on college campuses, including a client-facing slideshow of key student organization types, tailored outreach email templates, and polished presentation decks for each org type — giving YellowRed a complete toolkit for effective campus engagement.”
